scripts.//search: Pagefind is generated into dist/ by `postbuild` (scripts/build-pagefind.mjs, one bundle per product), but `astro dev` serves public/ -- so the indexes are copied there afterwards to make search work in dev. `prebuild` removes the previous copies first, otherwise Astro copies them into dist/ before Pagefind regenerates and the old content-hashed fragments pile up in the deployed output. public/pagefind*/ is gitignored.
scripts.postbuild: npm run build:pagefind && cp -r dist/pagefind public/pagefind && cp -r dist/pagefind-arcus public/pagefind-arcus
scripts.//verify:dist: Pre-deploy gate on dist/, run by the deploy workflow after `npm run build`. Names no content path on purpose -- see the header comment in the script.
